title: Local finite-scalar pullback tensor generator
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For every scheme $W$, let $B_{E,W,n}=(\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^{n+1})_W$ and $R_{E,W}=\varprojlim_n B_{E,W,n}$ be the actual coefficient sheaves [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients] on its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $g:X\to Y$ be any scheme morphism, $P$ any cochain complex of $R_{E,Y}$-module sheaves, $i\in\mathbf Z$, and $n\in\mathbf N$. Write $D_{E,n}(P)=\operatorname{Res}_n g_n^*(P\otimes_{R_{E,Y}}B_{E,Y,n})$ using the recorded termwise reduction and module pullback [def-pur-integral-derived-operations], with sheaf tensors [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] and the canonical inverse-image adjunction unit $\gamma_{g,n}$ [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. For a pro-etale test object $V\to Y$, a section $p\in P^i(V)$, a section $a\in B_{E,Y,n}(V)$ and a section $b\in B_{E,X,n}(X\times_Y V)$, define the local finite-scalar pullback generator in $D_{E,n}(P)^i(X\times_Y V)$ by $\operatorname{gen}_{g,E,n,P,i,V}(p,a,b)=b\,\gamma_{g,n}(p\otimes a)$, equivalently $(g^{-1}(p\otimes a))\otimes b$. Here $n$ denotes positive exponent $n+1$, all coefficients and restrictions are the actual quotient sheaf data, and no flatness, K-flatness, constructibility or isomorphism condition on $g$ is required.

def scalarPullbackGenerator {X Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{t}} (g : X ⟶ Y)
    (n : ℕ) (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E Y) ℤ) (i : ℤ)
    (V : Y.ProEt) (p : (P.X i).val.obj (op V))
    (a : (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y n).obj.obj (op V))
    (b : (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E X n).obj.obj
      (op ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.proEtaleBaseChange g).obj V))) :
    ((((integralOperationsPullbackLevel l E g n).obj P).X i).val.obj
      (op ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.proEtaleBaseChange g).obj V)))
